records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: Consolidated net sales for the first quarter of 2024 totaled $311.0 million, a 1.7% increase as compared to consolidated net sales of $305.8 million in the first quarter of 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: Our operating performance during the first quarter of 2024 has benefited from fewer supply chain disruptions enabling us to obtain key component parts, increase production and reduce backlog.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: Our order backlog was $136.7 million at March 31, 2024 compared to $186.2 million at December 31, 2023.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: •Organic sales growth of 5.1% was driven primarily by price realization in North America and price realization and volume increases in Latin America.

records.title: FORM 10-Q FOR THE QUARTER ENDED MARCH 31, 2024
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities during the three months ended March 31, 2024 was $2.9 million compared to net cash provided by operating activities of $31.1 million during the three months ended March 31, 2023.
